title: Commercial Bridging Finance

seo.title: Commercial Property Bridging for Companies & SPVs | CredX
seo.description: Short-term commercial and mixed-use property finance for corporate borrowers. Business-purpose lending only.

content:
Short-term finance for corporate borrowers acquiring, refinancing or improving commercial and mixed-use property for business or investment purposes.

What is Commercial Bridging Finance?

Commercial bridging finance is a short-term loan designed to help you fund the purchase or refurbishment of commercial properties. This type of loan is ideal for corporate borrowers that need fast access to capital where mainstream bank funding cannot meet the transaction timetable.
